questions.question: Which tense fits a fixed timetable?
questions.explanation: Present simple can describe scheduled future events.
answers: The train will leaves at 8 tomorrow.

questions.question: Choose the future simple sentence.
questions.explanation: Will + base verb forms the future simple.
answers: I think it will rain tomorrow.
I think it will rains tomorrow.

questions.question: Which is a future fact?
questions.explanation: A scheduled future event can use present simple.
answers: The shop opens at nine tomorrow.
The shop opened at nine yesterday.
The shop opens every day at nine.
